issues.should_be: Complete chapter covering all automatic filtering mechanisms
issues.fix_suggestion: Write complete chapter covering: ignore file types (.gitignore, .ignore, .rgignore, etc.), hidden files, binary files, symlinks, precedence rules, and examples

issues.description: No documentation of ripgrep's automatic ignore file handling
issues.should_add: Explain that ripgrep respects .gitignore, .ignore, .rgignore files automatically. Document precedence: .ignore > .gitignore > .git/info/exclude > global gitignore > custom ignore files. Show how parent directories are respected.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add section explaining ignore file types, precedence rules, and how they work during recursive search. Include examples showing each type.

issues.description: No documentation of automatic hidden file filtering
issues.should_add: Explain that hidden files (starting with .) are skipped by default. Show how -./--hidden overrides this. Explain platform-specific hidden file attributes on Windows.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add section on hidden file filtering with examples showing default behavior and --hidden flag usage

issues.description: No documentation of automatic binary file detection and filtering
issues.should_add: Explain NUL byte heuristic for binary detection. Show how --binary, --no-binary, and -a/--text flags control binary handling. Clarify that binary filtering only applies to recursive search.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add section explaining binary detection, when it applies (recursive search only), and how to control it with flags
issues.source_reference: features.json:file_filtering category, CLI help for --binary flag

issues.should_add: Document -u (no ignore files), -uu (no ignore + search hidden), -uuu (no ignore + hidden + binary). Show how --no-ignore, --no-ignore-dot, --no-ignore-vcs, etc. provide fine-grained control.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add section showing progressive unrestricted flags and individual --no-ignore-* flags with examples

issues.description: No explanation of how different ignore files interact
issues.should_add: Explain that .ignore files override all .gitignore files regardless of directory hierarchy. Within each type, more nested files have higher precedence. Parent directories are respected by default.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add detailed precedence section with examples showing how nested .ignore vs .gitignore files interact

issues.description: No documentation of --ignore-file flag for custom ignore files
issues.should_add: Show how --ignore-file can add custom ignore file paths. Explain these have lowest precedence but are never disabled by --no-ignore.

issues.description: No mention of .git/info/exclude or global gitignore
issues.should_add: Document that ripgrep respects .git/info/exclude and global gitignore (usually $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/git/ignore). Show how --no-ignore-vcs and --no-ignore-global disable these.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add subsection explaining VCS ignore files and global ignore files

issues.description: No explanation of ! prefix for whitelisting in ignore files
issues.should_add: Explain that patterns starting with ! in .gitignore/.ignore files whitelist paths, overriding earlier ignore rules.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add explanation and example of whitelist patterns

issues.description: No explanation of how explicit file paths override ignore rules
issues.should_add: Document that files specified directly on command line are always searched, even if they would be ignored by .gitignore
issues.fix_suggestion: Add note explaining that explicit file paths bypass ignore logic

issues.should_add: Explain --no-require-git allows .gitignore to be respected even outside git repositories
issues.fix_suggestion: Add brief mention of --no-require-git in appropriate subsection

issues.should_add: Document that --no-ignore-messages suppresses errors from malformed ignore files
issues.fix_suggestion: Add brief note about --no-ignore-messages for suppressing ignore file errors

issues.should_add: Mention --ignore-file-case-insensitive for case-insensitive glob matching in ignore files (useful on Windows)
issues.fix_suggestion: Add note about case-insensitive ignore file matching

issues.should_add: Explain that --no-ignore-parent prevents reading ignore files from parent directories
issues.fix_suggestion: Add brief mention in ignore files section
